title: [attachments] v2 tracking: parent-visibility inheritance, authed downloads, remaining enforce-or-remove
body:
Tracking issue for the follow-ups surfaced while landing #2755 (PR #2969). **All items complete.**

## Read / visibility
- [x] **Attachment read visibility inherits parent-record visibility.** ✅ #2984 — `sys_attachment`-scoped engine middleware (filters find/findOne/count/aggregate, so list `total` can't leak the hidden count).
- [x] **Authenticated downloads.** ✅ #2984 — `GET /storage/files/:fileId(/url)` gate attachments-scope files: 401 without a session, 403 `ATTACHMENT_DOWNLOAD_DENIED` without owner/parent-read, else a short-lived signed URL. objectui #2538 switches the panel to fetch the signed URL with auth.

## Enforcement strength
- [x] **Edit-on-parent for attach.** ✅ #2984 — create requires `sharing.canEdit` on the parent, not merely read.

## Lifecycle
- [x] **`sys_upload_session` lifecycle.** ✅ #2984 — ADR-0057 `transient` (TTL 1d past `expires_at`; retention 7d terminal statuses).

## Enforce-or-remove (ADR-0049)
- [x] **`sys_attachment.enable.trash`.** ✅ #2984 — set to `false` (dead flag, hard deletes).

## Dogfood
- [x] **Showcase browser dogfood.** ✅ #2984 — `showcase_project` opts into `enable.files`; browser-verified end-to-end.

## Sub-follow-up
- [x] **`sys_upload_session` multipart-abort reap guard.** ✅ #2999 — a `LifecycleReapGuard` aborts the backend multipart upload (S3 `AbortMultipartUpload` / local parts dir) before an abandoned/terminal session row is reaped, so its already-uploaded parts don't leak. Skips `completed` sessions, re-seeds the S3 key for cold sweeps, vetoes on abort failure. Dogfood drives a real chunked upload → part on disk → sweep → row gone + parts aborted.

Source: #2755 v1 follow-ups. All landed across #2984 (six items) + #2999 (sub-item); shipped to tenants via cloud #838.

Everything is done — closing.
